ggplot(data.h, aes(gaussian.gain)) + geom_density()

ggplot(data.h, aes(log.gain)) + geom_density()

ggplot(data.h, aes(Gain_Beta)) + geom_density()

Looks like the effect sizes for motor trend in differences acorss many other of the conditions. Motor is fairly different from the cog domains we consider and is sometimes thought of as it's own thing ( motor skills vs. cognitive skills). So we may see peoples intuitions about motor cognition is different than that of others when considering treatments
